description_en: Queries the configuration history of a specified resource. Cloud Config records every configuration change and resource relationship change of resources and organizes them into a configuration history. After you activate Cloud Config, it starts recording the configuration and resource relationship changes of resources and retains the records for 10 years by default
description_zh: 查询指定资源的配置变更历史。配置审计记录资源的每一次配置变更和资源关系变更，并整理为配置变更历史。您开通配置审计服务后，配置审计开始记录资源的配置变更和资源关系变更历史，并默认保存10年
kebab_example: aliyun config get-resource-configuration-timeline --resource-id new-bucket --resource-type ACS::OSS::Bucket --biz-region cn-hangzhou --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou

ResourceEventType.description_en:
The type of the resource change event. Valid values:

DISCOVERED: The resource event newly discovered by Cloud Config.
DISCOVERED_REVISED: The resource event newly discovered by Cloud Config through a periodic correction task.
MODIFY: The resource modification event.
MODIFY_REVISED: The resource modification event generated by a periodic correction task.
REMOVE: The resource deletion event.

To ensure resource integrity, Cloud Config periodically aligns data through periodic correction tasks and generates newly discovered resource events. These events occur at a low frequency.
The time when a resource event is generated by a periodic correction task is the task discovery time, which is later than the actual change time of the resource
ResourceEventType.description_zh:
资源变更事件的类型。取值：

DISCOVERED：配置审计新发现的资源事件。
DISCOVERED_REVISED：配置审计新发现的通过周期订正任务产生的资源事件。
MODIFY：修改资源事件。
MODIFY_REVISED：通过周期订正任务产生的修改资源事件。
REMOVE：删除资源事件。

配置审计为了保障资源完整，通过周期订正任务对数据进行周期性对齐，产生新发现资源事件，该事件发生的频率较低。
通过周期订正任务产生资源事件的时间为任务发现时间，该时间晚于资源的实际变更时间
